worlds.name: Fromville Nights
worlds.description: A trapped-town survival story with talismans, looping roads, and groups of grey smiling night creatures outside after dark.
worlds.chapterEnding: The station door slams shut. The creatures gather outside, smiling at the windows, while the ink road tears open toward another story.

worlds.name: Neon Exorcists
worlds.description: An anime occult-horror story beneath a city railway, with paper seals, shrine tunnels, and pale burrow ghouls.
worlds.chapterEnding: The paper seals ignite one by one. The final torii gate opens and the underground railway disappears into white ink.

worlds.name: Blackthorn Manor
worlds.description: A gothic television-horror story about a blackout manor, attic radio messages, and revenants waiting beyond the windows.
worlds.chapterEnding: The attic radio falls silent. Every window seals at once, and the manor shrinks into a black rectangle on the next page.

worlds.name: Spirit Trail Grove
worlds.description: An anime spirit-forest story with foxfire, looping bamboo paths, bottle charms, and a yellow whisper that imitates friendly voices.
worlds.chapterEnding: The bottle charms swing without wind. The moon gate opens between two bamboo trunks and the painted forest folds flat.

worlds.name: False City Terminal
worlds.description: A surreal city thriller where streets loop, transit officers lie, and an impossible terminal pretends to be freedom.
worlds.chapterEnding: The false skyline repeats one last time, then every building collapses into ruled paper. No recovered page follows.
